name: Guardian
note: Soul reward is the team total. Also has a resist that decays over the match (+50% to -50% over 12 min, patch note 2026-05-22), not in the files read.

name: Walker
note: health / second / third: each Walker left standing gets tougher as others die. Soul reward is the team total. Decaying resist +65% to -65% over 18 min (patch note 2026-03-06). Latest patch note on bullet resist says +15%; files say 35.

name: Base Guardian
note: Soul reward is the team total.

name: Shrine
note: health is the first Shrine, health_second the other once one has died. Invulnerable until a pair of Base Guardians is destroyed (patch note 2026-05-22).

name: Patron
note: health_gain_per_minute applies from minute 20 (phase 1). Files say 12000 / 12000; the last patch note giving Patron health (2024-12-06) said 7500 / 13500.

name: Mid Boss
note: Present from 0:00. Health is fixed when it spawns: base plus gain per minute of game time. Respawn shortens by 60s per kill down to 300s. Soaks a flat amount of damage per second, growing 5 per minute. Files say 15600 health; latest patch note (2026-03-06) says 13000.

name: Trooper
note: Health is +50% after 35 minutes. Bounty is in the Rules table.

name: Medic Trooper
note: Health is +50% after 35 minutes. Damage grows 3% per minute.

name: Small camp creep
note: Values are per creep at minute 0.

name: Medium camp creep
note: Values are per creep at minute 0.

name: Large camp creep
note: Values are per creep at minute 0. Patch notes imply a 420s respawn; files say 335.

name: Sinner's Sacrifice
note: Melee only: bullets and abilities do nothing. Health is a hit counter. Returns 80 damage per hit.
